خَرَجَ مُتَمَطِّرًا He went forth into the gardens and fields after rain. (A.) ＝
-A2- طَائِرٌ مُتَمَطِّرٌ (tropical:) A bird hastening, or going quickly, (S, TA,) in its descent; (TA;) [as also ↓ مَاطِرٌ , of which the pl., مُطَّرٌ, occurs in the following ex.:] Ru-beh says, “وَالطَّيْرُ تَهْوِى فِى السَّمَآءِ مُطَّرًا
” [And the birds descend in the sky, hastening]. (TA.) مُتَمَطِّرٌ is also applied to a horseman, as signifying hastening, or going quickly. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
